simulcast.title: Simulcast
simulcast.intro: Restream to other platforms from our servers, so your upload stays the same.
simulcast.emptyHint: Add a target below and it goes live with you.
simulcast.name: Name
simulcast.urlHint: An rtmp:// or rtmps:// ingest address from the other platform.
simulcast.keyHint: Write-only: it is never shown again.
simulcast.limitReached: You have 5 targets, the most a channel can have. Remove one to add another.
simulcast.removeBody: The stream key is deleted with it. You can add the target again later.
simulcast.error.format: Enter an address that starts with rtmp:// or rtmps://.
simulcast.error.credentials: Put credentials in the stream key, not in the URL.
simulcast.error.url: That server cannot be used. Check the address the other platform gave you.
simulcast.error.limit: You already have 5 targets. Remove one to add another.
simulcast.error.generic: The target could not be added. Try again.
simulcast.actionFailed: That change could not be saved. Try again.
simulcast.loadFailed: Your simulcast targets could not be loaded.
overlays.title: Alerts & overlays
overlays.intro: Choose which alerts appear on stream, then add the overlay URL to OBS as a browser source.

overlays.tokenLoadFailed: The overlay URL status could not be loaded.
overlays.alert.subscriptionHint: When someone subscribes, and once for every gifted sub.
overlays.alert.raidHint: When another channel sends its viewers to you.
overlays.alert.raidNote: Raid alerts fire once raids are available.
overlays.alert.messageError: Write a message of up to 200 characters.
overlays.alert.minAmountHint: Smaller tips do not trigger the alert.
overlays.alert.minAmountError: Enter an amount of zero or more.
overlays.alert.testSent: Test alert sent to your overlay.
overlays.alert.failed: That did not work. Try again.
overlays.preview.label: Alert preview
overlays.token.title: Overlay URL
overlays.token.intro: Add it to OBS as a browser source. Anyone with the link sees your alerts.
overlays.token.expiryDatePast: Pick a time in the future.
overlays.token.createdToast: Overlay URL created. Copy it now: it is shown only once.
overlays.token.rotateBody: The current URL stops working at once. Paste the new one into OBS.
overlays.token.urlHint: Shown once. Copy it now, and keep it out of screenshots and streams.
overlays.token.copyFailed: Could not copy the overlay URL
overlays.token.revokeBody: Alerts stop showing in OBS until you create a new URL.
overlays.token.failed: The overlay URL could not be changed. Try again.
overlay.goalsLater: Goal bars are not available yet. This URL will show them once they are.
overlay.chatLater: The chat overlay is not available yet. This URL will show it once it is.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Download your data or delete your account.
privacy.export.title: Export your data
privacy.export.intro: A zip of JSON files with everything we hold about you. The link works for 7 days.
privacy.export.cooldown: One export a day: available again {time}
privacy.export.emptyHint: We email you a link when an export is ready.
privacy.export.kind.accountHint: Profile, sessions, follows, payments, chat, co-op and safety records.
privacy.export.kind.channelHint: Settings, VOD and clip lists, revenue and payouts.
privacy.export.requestedToast: Export requested. We email you when it is ready.
privacy.export.rateLimited: You can request one export of each kind a day.
privacy.export.failed: The export could not be requested. Try again.
privacy.export.loadFailed: Your exports could not be loaded.

privacy.deletion.intro: Your profile, messages and media are removed after a grace period.

privacy.deletion.scheduled: Your account will be deleted on {date}. Until then you can cancel.
privacy.deletion.scheduledToast: Deletion scheduled. We emailed you the date.
privacy.deletion.failed: That did not work. Try again.
